description: Remove the background from an image, leaving the subject on a transparent (or solid color) background. Accepts an image URL or base64-encoded image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or still GIF, up to 20 MB) and returns the processed image. For animated GIFs and videos use remove_video_background. Can also crop to the subject and resize the result to an exact width x height without stretching (width, height, fit). Costs 1 credit.

bg_color.description: Background color (hex, rgb, or color name). Only applies when channels is 'rgb'. Example: '#ffffff'

channels.description: Output color channels. Use 'rgba' for transparency, 'rgb' for an opaque background (bg_color, white by default), 'alpha' for the grayscale alpha mask only

crop.description: Whether to crop the image to the subject bounds

fit.description: How to fit the image into width x height. 'contain' pads the remaining area (transparent or bg_color), 'cover' fills the canvas and crops the overflow around the subject, 'scale-down' is like contain but never enlarges a smaller image

format.description: Output image format. 'jpg' has no transparency

height.description: Output height in pixels. On its own, the width follows the aspect ratio. With width, the image is fitted into an exact width x height canvas without stretching

image.description: Image input: a publicly accessible URL to a PNG, JPEG, WebP or still GIF image (including https://), or base64-encoded image data (optionally as a data: URL). Animated GIFs are videos: use remove_video_background

size.description: Output image size preset (megapixel cap). Ignored when width or height is set

width.description: Output width in pixels. On its own, the height follows the aspect ratio. With height, the image is fitted into an exact width x height canvas without stretching

name: remove_background
title: Remove Image Background
